restrictions: The two messages have 1024t + 55 and 1024t + 63 bytes for one t with 1 <= t < 2^32: t zero chunks of 1024 bytes followed by a last chunk of one block. The last chunk is compressed as a non-root chunk with counter t (v12 = t, v13 = 0), flags 3 and its true block length; the 63-byte block ends in eight zero bytes, so words 14 and 15 and the top byte of word 13 are zero in both zero-filled blocks. Equal last-chunk chaining values give equal digests by the tree lemma of proof.md Section 7.
Unkeyed BLAKE3-256 with 2 prefix rounds, standard IV, permutation and feed-forward, full 256-bit digest; an ordinary collision between two distinct complete messages.

Exact part: for every trial of proof.md Section 8 the two last-chunk chaining values agree on words 0, 2, 5 and 7, E1.c1 lies in the cube of beta* = 18b0e098 so that beta = beta* in every trial, Y4 ranges over the whole class of eta (524,288 values; no sub-class, no rule on h1), and the counter t is solved per trial as ROL(K0.d1,16) XOR K0.a1; trials with t = 0 are skipped. Only outer steps that pass the exact filter of proof.md Section 8 are searched further: by Lemma F an outer step that fails it holds no trial with R = 0 and one of the seven listed E1 outcomes of beta* (tau ending in 5020a0), so no counted success is lost; it passes 312,881,258,079 / 2^48 = 2^-9.8132 of uniform word pairs. Successes with the seven other outcomes of beta* on the class are not counted. Heuristic part: a search over 2^90.463 walked trials (2^69.463 outer steps of 2^21) for one whose remaining 128 chaining-value bits agree succeeds with probability at least 0.39 under H1' and H4'.

Classical 256-bit word RAM under collision-frontier-v5, 430 machine units (operations, loads, stores) per unit, on a 64-register load/store machine with immediate constants; each fetch of a memory word costs one load. Outer steps run seven to a batch on packed 36-bit lanes: 640 units per batch (proof.md 9.6). Only a passing step runs its rebuild (512) and the joint solver of proof.md 9.4 for its listed outcomes, one depth-first traversal over E3.h1 with guards proved lossless on the whole class (the parity certificate P* and the j0 guard), with the certificate of each root: at most 37,032 units whatever its words, a proved upper allowance of a specified layout, not a measured or implemented count. No sorting, no lookup by value, no table that grows with the trials. The algorithm halts with failure when more than PASS_BUDGET steps pass or after RUN_BATCHES batches; each row is charged at its budget and no mean of a work count is used (proof.md Sections 9, 11).

Randomized by eight fresh uniform 256-bit words per batch of seven outer steps; each outer step reads its own disjoint bits (proof.md Lemma PL), so the outer steps are independent with the law of one drawn alone. Success 0.39 holds only under heuristics H1' and H4'. The factor 99,033,509,302 in H1' is five sevenths of the model's conditional count of the seven listed outcomes on the class, rounded down, and is not measured by the organizer-run experiments, which run the root instance (counter 0, flags 11): no digest experiment can show a half-collision of a non-root chunk's chaining value. The filter is exact; that the sampler's pass share equals 2^-9.8132 enters only the pass budget (H4'). No full 2-round collision is exhibited. The submitted program is that of entry 26ebba63, unchanged (the earlier sub-class version of this search, with the same outcomes, filter, factor and run length). This search's member, batch, pass budget, joint solver with its layout, and certificate are defined in proof.md only.

Six 32-bit constants, the word eta, the beta* cube (beta*, mask, value) and the seven tau values and eps of the filter are what the search reads (72 bytes); the program also stores the two sub-class bits and the rule-A words of its root instance (92 bytes of advice in all). The constants were found by a participant's solver search and chosen by one exact count per model; beta* is the beta of that solution. preprocessing_log2 55 bounds the selection procedure of proof.md Section 12 (below 2^62.946 operations) in full and is included in time_log2: the search alone is below 2^67.8003 units, the selection below 2^54.198. That the selection returns these constants rests on participant records and a stated, unproved operation-rate bridge. memory_log2_bytes 44 covers the two output messages (each below 2^42 bytes), the code, selection and search, all held at once (sum below 2^44). No priority or novelty claim is made.

heuristics.statement: Score-critical. Over the run's RUN_STEPS independent uniform 256-bit words, let N_o be the number of listed good valid trials of one outer step (t != 0, R = 0, and an E1 outcome among the seven outcomes of beta* with tau ending in 5020a0, Y4 in the whole class of eta; no rule on h1), counted over all of Q* whether or not the outer step passes the filter. (i) E[N_o] >= (2^21 - 1) q with q = FACTOR * 2^-128, FACTOR = floor(5 * 138,646,913,024 / 7) = 99,033,509,302, about 2^-91.473 (just under five sevenths of the conditional model rate p of Lemma S1 for these seven outcomes). (ii) The probability that no valid trial of the run is a listed good trial is at most exp(-0.49676) + 0.001. Given (i), rho = E[N_o(N_o-1)]/E[N_o] <= 0.0065 is sufficient for (ii) by Lemma S8. This restates the rate-and-dependence premise of entry 26ebba63 for the whole class with these seven outcomes. The factor and the run length are that entry's, but its accepted clause was for the sub-class of 2^17 members with rule A and does not by itself imply this whole-class law: equal model counts and equal budget constants do not identify the law of N_o, and rho need not be the same (GPT Sol, answer AT 2). It is declared here anew. By Lemma F (exact) every listed good trial lies in an outer step that passes the filter, so N_o is zero on rejected outer steps (Lemma S9) and the rate per member of Q* of a passing outer step is q / pi_o, about 2^-81.660 if pi_o equals the exact share pi.
heuristics.scope: Exactly the trials of proof.md Sections 8 and 9: lengths 1024t + 55 and 1024t + 63 with a non-root last chunk (counter t, v13 = 0, flags 3), the six constants of Section 3.2, Y4 a member of the whole class of eta (524,288 values, Lemma Q) drawn with the outer words from the run's fresh 256-bit words (seven outer steps to a batch, each on its own disjoint bits, Lemma PL), E1.c1 drawn from the cube of beta* = 18b0e098 in every trial, t solved per trial and t = 0 skipped. Only outer steps that pass the exact seven-outcome filter of Section 8 (the program's own) are searched further; N_o counts all of Q* in every outer step and only the seven listed outcomes.
heuristics.extrapolation: From the participant's exact count, in integer arithmetic under the seven-word model of Section 10 with Y4 uniform in the class, of the part of beta* on the class carried by the seven listed outcomes (67,698,688 = 1,033 * 2^16 on the per-trial scale 2^-83 of the class; the counting program and the seven rows of its output are printed in Section 17), times 2^11 for drawing E1.c1 from the cube (Lemma S1: conditioning the model on the cube does not bias the E3 side), taken at five sevenths, rounded down. The filter changes neither the count nor the premise: under the model all of p lies on passing outer steps (Lemma S9 (b)). Participant evidence of Section 13, untrusted by the harness: a whole-class graphics-card run of 2^46 real counter trials in 2^25 passing outer steps, with a sub-class control of the same size, in which every measured quantity matches the exact model within 1.5 clustered standard errors, among them the E1 rate of exactly these seven outcomes on the whole class, 1.0020 +- 0.0086 of the model (13,595 events), and its ratio to the sub-class rate, 0.9895 +- 0.0120 (model 1); 2^43 real trials inside passing outer steps of this seven-outcome filter on the sub-class, listed E1 outcome 0.979 +- 0.022 of its value; and a reduced-width (8-bit) end-to-end run of complete messages, with no sub-class and no rule, in which the counter arrangement found 251 collisions against 255.0 predicted. The joint 128-bit event itself, about 2^-91 per trial, is not measured at 32 bits.
heuristics.limitations: The factor 99,033,509,302 is assumed (five sevenths of the model count of the seven outcomes on the class, rounded down). The accepted premise of entry 26ebba63 was for the sub-class with rule A; it is not inherited, and the whole-class law of N_o is declared, not proved. The organizer-run experiments run the root instance (counter 0, flags 11) of the same construction and measure neither the factor nor the counter half-collision, which no digest experiment can show. The transfer of the single-trial law to the actual sampler is partly proved (Lemmas S1-S5, S8, S9) and partly assumed in (i); the weak-dependence condition of (ii) is assumed, with a proved cap of 48 listed good trials in one outer step (Lemma CV). The whole-class graphics-card run measures the E1 side and the filter, not the E3 side of the seven outcomes on the class (N3 four times that of the sub-class) nor the joint event, and its trials lie in passing outer steps of the fourteen-outcome filter, a superset of this filter's. Lemma F and Lemma S9 (a) use no law of the words; the 8-bit end-to-end run has no filter.

heuristics.statement: Supporting. With probability at least 0.9995 over the coins, at most PASS_BUDGET = 961,264,466,727,415,004 outer steps of a run pass the filter (about 2^59.738: RUN_STEPS times the exact share pi = SHARE / 2^64 = 2^-9.8132 of the seven-outcome filter, times 17/16, rounded up), so the pass-count halt is not reached. Reaching it halts with failure; the time bound charges PASS_BUDGET + 1 passing outer steps.
heuristics.scope: The seven-outcome outer filter of proof.md Section 8 (the program's own) on the outer steps of step 1 of Section 9.1, with Y4 drawn from the whole class: the number of passing outer steps of a run, which is binomial with RUN_STEPS independent steps (Lemma PL) and the sampler's pass probability pi_o (Lemma S9).
heuristics.extrapolation: pi is exact for independent uniform pairs (Y9, Y3 + Y4 + w8), with a certificate in Section 8 (GPT Sol, answers AC and AN), recounted by the program's self-test. If pi_o <= 1.06 pi, the Chernoff bound puts more than PASS_BUDGET passing outer steps below exp(-2 * 10^12). Measured (Section 13, untrusted by the harness): with this seven-outcome filter and members of the sub-class, 2^-9.8127 against 2^-9.8132 on 2^22 passing steps, and 1.00012 +- 0.00016 of the exact share on 2^35 outer steps of a graphics-card control; on the whole class, the fourteen-outcome filter passes 0.99990 +- 0.00007 of its exact share on 2^35 outer steps.
heuristics.limitations: That pi_o equals pi, or is at most 1.06 pi, is not proved: the sampler's Y9 and Y3 + Y4 + w8 are not proved independent and uniform. This seven-outcome filter was measured with members of the sub-class; on the whole class only the fourteen-outcome filter was measured. The time bound and the exactness of the filter do not depend on pi_o.
